summary: Today brings a legally and commercially focused news cycle driven by capital market regulatory approvals and key judicial orders. Primary drivers include SEBI's clearance for Ratnadeep Retail's IPO and major appellate rulings from the Supreme Court and Gujarat High Court.

bullets.text: SEBI approved value-fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail's IPO, comprising a fresh issue of up to ₹400 crore and a 1.49 crore share offer-for-sale.
Reliance Jio reported a 14% profit jump shortly following its blockbuster initial public offering.
Gujarat High Court restored a ban on non-vegetarian eateries near Somnath Temple, overruling a single-judge order passed hours earlier.
The Supreme Court reprimanded the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity for ignoring binding judicial precedents, stating the tribunal had gone haywire.
Supreme Court initiated contempt proceedings against Kerala Congress following a lawyer's petition regarding a social media post against the Chief Justice of India.
